note: The 1.4.0 and 1.6.0 runs use different hosts. Each ratio divides reference-tool time by RapidGLM time within the same run; changes compare ratios, not cross-host seconds.

egene_identity.rule: Storey q < 0.05 using the same qvalue interface

glm_engine.scope: Same n >= 100,000 problems in both receipts, one thread; median per-problem reference/RapidGLM ratios.

rust.note: The Rust workflow uses unfloored NB fits; the Python inference backend uses floored fits from 1.4.0. Low-count and boundary-fit results therefore need not match.
